paper_title: Efficient Ensemble for Fine-tuning Language Models on Multiple Datasets
caption: Illustrating the empirical generalization errors and sharpness measures with respect to QLoRA weights. (<ref>) Smaller adapters with a rank of 16 achieve the lowest generalization errors. Additionally, the Hessian trace values correlate with generalization errors, suggesting that smaller adapters tend to converge to flatter minima. (<ref>) An ensemble of k adapters leads to lower generalization errors and Hessian traces. Here, we fix the sum of the dimensions of k adapters to be equal to 256. (<ref>) QLoRA, which is trained on a quantized base model, yields lower generalization errors and Hessian trace values compared to LoRA.

annotations.annotation: Die Abbildung ist ein Liniendiagramm und veranschaulicht die Variation von „Traces × 10^-5 (COPA)“ in Bezug auf verschiedene Ränge. Die horizontale Achse ist beschriftet mit “Rang“ und verwendet eine lineare Skala von 4 bis 256 mit Teilstrichen bei 4, 16, 64 und 256. Die vertikale Achse verwendet ebenfalls eine lineare Skala mit einem Bereich von 0,0 bis 12,0 und Teilstrichen im Abstand von 4,0. Das Diagramm enthält eine schwarze Linie mit orangenen quadratischen Markierungen. Die Linie startet mit 1,0 bei 4, bleibt bei 16 auf 1,0, steigt dann auf 3,5 bei 64 und steigt weiter auf 0,7 bei 256. Das Diagramm enthält Fehlermarkierungen an jeder Markierung.

The plot illustrates the variation of "Traces × 10^-5 (COPA)" for different ranks. The x-axis is labeled "Rank," using an exponential scale with a value range from 4 to 256, and tick marks at intervals of 4, 16, 64, and 256. The y-axis represents "Traces × 10^-5 (COPA)" on a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 8.0 with tick label intervals of 4.0. The plot features a single line in black with square markers highlighted in orange, connected by a solid line style. At the initial rank of 4, the trace value is approximately 0.5. This value remains nearly constant until rank 16. The line then shows a gradual increase, reaching around 3.0 at rank 64. Finally, the line exhibits a steeper rise, culminating at approximately 7.0 at rank 256. Error bars are present at each marker location to indicate variability, with the marker at the x-value of 16 having the lowest spread and the x-value of 64 having the highest spread.

The line plot illustrates the variation of "Traces × 10^-5 (COPA)" with respect to different ranks. The x-axis is labeled "Rank", using a linear scale with a value range from 4 to 256, and tick marks at intervals of 4, 16, 64, and 256. The y-axis represents "Traces × 10^-5 (COPA)", but the label text is on top center of the plot, and is on a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 8.0 with tick label intervals of 4.0. The plot features a single line in black with square markers highlighted in orange, connected by a solid line style. At the initial rank of 4, the trace value is approximately 0.75. This value remains nearly constant until rank 16. The line then shows a gradual increase, reaching around 4.0 at rank 64. Finally, the line rises, culminating at approximately 7.0 at rank 256. Error bars are present at each marker location. No legend is given.

Линейната графика илюстрира вариацията на „Следи × 10^-5 (COPA)“ спрямо различните рангове. Оста x е обозначена като „Ранг“, използвайки експоненциална скала с диапазон на стойностите от 4 до 256 и отметки на интервали от 4, 16, 64 и 256. Оста y представлява „Следи × 10^-5 (COPA)“ в линейна скала, варираща от 0,0 до 8,0 с интервали на отметките от 4,0. Графиката включва една линия в черно с квадратни маркери, маркирани в оранжево, свързани с плътна линия. При начален ранг 4, стойността на следата е приблизително 1,5. Тази стойност остава почти постоянна до ранг 16. След това линията показва постепенно увеличение, достигайки около 4,0 при ранг 64. Накрая линията показва по-стръмно покачване, достигайки кулминация при приблизително 7,0 при ранг 256.

The plot illustrates the variation of traces, scaled by 0^-5 with respect to different ranks. The x-axis is labeled "Rank" and has a linear scale with a value range from 4 to 256, and tick marks at intervals of 4, 16, 64, and 256. The y-axis represents "Traces × 10^-5 (COPA)" on a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 8.0 with tick label intervals of 4.0. The plot features a single line in black with square markers highlighted in orange, connected by a solid line style. At the initial rank of 4, the trace value is approximately 1. This value remains nearly constant until rank 16. The line then shows a gradual increase, reaching around 3.5 at rank 64. Finally, the line exhibits a steeper rise, culminating at approximately 7.5 at rank 256.
